basic_details.job_title: ESIC Medical College & Hospital Ahmedabad Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 66 Professor, Associate Professor and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and 1 more
basic_details.short_information: Employees State Insurance Corporation Medical College & Hospital Ahmedabad (ESIC Medical College & Hospital Ahmedabad), Gujarat, has invited applications for 66 posts in 4 roles under Advt No. 03 of 2026. The posts include Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 27 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft in favor of ESI Fund A/c No.- 1 payable at Ahmedabad.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 1,18,500, depending on the post

how_to_apply: Fill out the offline application form attached with the advertisement.
Bring the completed offline application form along with self-attested copies of required documents at the time of document verification.
Submit separate applications for multiple posts if applying for more than one.
important_instructions: Candidates who report after 10:00 AM on the specified interview date will be considered absent. The selected candidate must submit a Security Deposit via Demand Draft upon joining.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Non-medical officers, if selected, are not entitled to Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA). Initial period of 1 year, extendable up to 3 years at the outset, and a maximum tenure of 5 years. Contract will be terminated upon appointment of regular faculty or attainment of 70 years of age for faculty and 50 years for Senior Resident, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Demand Draft in favor of ESI Fund A/c No.- 1 payable at Ahmedabad.

content_sections.heading: How Will ESIC Medical College & Hospital Ahmedabad Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Document verification by the Document Verification Committee Interview conducted by the selection board Selection will be made on the basis of acquired academic credentials and performance of candidate in interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certificate of passing Class 10th for Date of Birth All Marks Sheets, Attempt, Degree Certificate of MBBS Valid EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwBD Certificate issued in format for appointment in Central Govt. job State/ NMC Medical Registration Certificate (updated) Proof of Publication(s) Experience Certificate Recent Passport Size Photograph of Candidate Relieving/NOC Certificate from previous/current Employer, if applicable

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates who report after 10:00 AM on the specified interview date will be considered absent. The selected candidate must submit a Security Deposit via Demand Draft upon joining.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ESIC Medical College & Hospital Ahmedabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ESIC Medical College & Hospital Ahmedabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 66 vacancies: 9 Professor, 16 Associate Professor, 10 Assistant Professor, 31 Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ESIC Medical College & Hospital Ahmedabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 27 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: SC/ST/ESIC Regular Employee/Female/Ex-servicemen/PH: Nil. All Other categories: Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Professor: maximum 67 years; Associate Professor: maximum 67 years; Assistant Professor: maximum 67 years; Senior Resident: maximum 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 1,18,500 (Level 13) + Other Allowances for Professor, Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 78,800 (Level 12) + Other Allowances for Associate Professor, Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700 (Level 11) + Other Allowances for Assistant Professor, Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700 (Level 11) + Other Allowances for Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS / MD / MS / DNB in accordance with NMC/MCI guidelines. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining as teaching faculty. Candidates working in Govt./Autonomous/Statutory Institution should preferably have NOC from their Employer at the time of Interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Document verification by the Document Verification Committee. Interview conducted by the selection board. Selection will be made on the basis of acquired academic credentials and performance of candidate in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial period of 1 year, extendable up to 3 years at the outset, and a maximum tenure of 5 years. Contract will be terminated upon appointment of regular faculty or attainment of 70 years of age for faculty and 50 years for Senior Resident, whichever is earlier.
